_comment: Which vendor categories an event of each type typically needs, as listing-type names.
Read by events-ui through config.vendorCategories — see its lib/schema-form/vendorCategories.ts.
It is the denominator behind 'still to find' on an event's Vendors tab and '1 of 5 booked' on
the host strip. A type that declares nothing falls back to every listing type with a landing
page, which is the behaviour this replaces: correct today only because every seeded vertical
happens to suit a wedding, and silently wrong the moment a sixth is published that does not.
Order matters and is preserved: it is the order the categories are offered in, so the first
entry is the one the type says to sort out first.
Only types listed here are pinned. Adding CORPORATE_EVENT or ANNIVERSARY_EVENT is one entry
each — but it is a product decision about what those events need, not a mechanical one, so
they are deliberately left on the fallback rather than guessed at.
